messages:
Aisha (CSM): Heads-up — SummitHealth raised a few onboarding blockers during today's check-in. They're seriously weighing renewal; want product to triage asap. TL;DR below + direct quotes.

Marcus (CS): thanks Aisha. dropping the summary here so PMs/eng can decide prioritization.

Aisha (CSM): 1) Feature request: per-route billing toggle so they can disable expensive embedding routes during pilot. Quote: "We can't prove ROI if the embedding bill is eating our budget"  (CS-4821).

Aisha (CSM): 2) Pain: confusing error surface in Private deploy onboarding — customers see `kv_cache_mismatch` and docs don't explain a mitigation. Causes lost time.

Aisha (CSM): 3) Ask: more granular enablement checklist for dedicated customers (networking, KMS, certs). They missed the HSM step.

Jill (Support): adding logs snippet they shared: ```
2026-03-21T16:02:11Z ERROR kv_cache_mismatch: expected 8MB got 0MB
config: private.deploy.v1
```

Tom (PM): Appreciate the context. For prioritization I'd put per-route billing toggle as high impact (direct ROI signal). Private onboarding docs and error mapping are quick wins — effort looks low.

Lena (Eng Prod): Per-route toggle: depends on whether we implement at router layer vs model config. Quick estimate: 2 sprints for a scoped toggle (routing flag + console UI).

Marcus (CS): SummitHealth willing to be a canary for the toggle if we can ship an opt-in within 6 weeks. They offered to pay for a small pilot.

Tom (PM): Okay — proposal: 1) Ship onboarding docs and error hunting doc this sprint (owner: Jill). 2) Scoped per-route billing toggle as next sprint work (owner: Lena). 3) Create a short enablement checklist template that CS can run during onboarding (owner: Aisha). Anyone object?

Jill (Support): I'll create a KB draft and link to the logs/known errors page. ETA Wed. :thumbsup:

Lena (Eng Prod): I'll write a tech spec for the toggle by EOW and flag integration risks. If SummitHealth can be a canary, that de-risks UX unknowns.

Tom (PM): I'll add the toggle to the roadmap and tag it with revenue risk so Sales/RevOps see it. Also want a follow-up sync with SummitHealth — Aisha can you take that?

Aisha (CSM): Yep, I'll schedule a 30-min demo + pilot readout for next Tue. I'll send their sample billing logs to the thread after the call.

feedback-bot: New intake created: CS-4821-per-route-toggle-pilot. Link: https://redwood.example/CS-4821 (internal).

Marcus (CS): great. Moving to action items: Jill -> KB, Lena -> spec, Tom -> roadmap + tag, Aisha -> pilot sync. I'll capture this in the customer-touch doc.

Tom (PM): One last ask: can Support add an explicit escalation path for private onboarding errors so CSMs know who to page? That would reduce churn risk.

Jill (Support): yes — adding a pager step + on-call rotation note to the onboarding checklist.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks team. If we get the toggle pilot funded that's likely enough for SummitHealth to sign. Will update after Tuesday. :crossed_fingers:
